title: Asiad: Cabañero, Gilas turn back Sri Lanka to stay perfect in 3x3 hoops
summary: Gilas Pilipinas Men remained perfect in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 3x3 basketball tournament after turning back Sri Lanka, 21-12, on Monday at the Kinjo Futo Station Square Venue in Japan.
